name: Cheera Thoran
subtitle: amaranth greens tossed dry with coconut, garlic and cumin

ingredients.qty: 500g with tender stems, washed and chopped fine
ingredients.note: red or green cheera both work

prepNotes: Wash the greens in three changes of water. Amaranth holds grit at the stem joints.
Chop the greens and stems finely and let them drain in a colander for 10 minutes; wet greens steam into a puddle.
Crush the coconut, garlic, green chilli, cumin and turmeric together roughly before you start. That mix is the thoran.

steps.text: Pound the coconut, garlic, green chilli, cumin seeds and turmeric together to a coarse, fragrant crumble. Do not make it a paste.
steps.tip: Coarse is correct. A smooth paste turns the thoran pasty instead of dry and flaky.

steps.text: Heat the coconut oil in a wide kadhai over medium-high and crackle the mustard seeds until they pop, about 30 seconds.
Add the dried red chillies and curry leaves and let them sizzle for 10 seconds.
Add the sliced shallots and fry 3-4 minutes until soft and just turning gold at the edges.
Tip in the chopped greens and the salt, raise the heat, and toss for 2 minutes until they collapse to a third of their volume.
steps.tip: Use your widest pan and high heat. Crowded greens release water and boil rather than fry.

steps.text: Cook uncovered 4-5 minutes, tossing occasionally, until the water the greens threw off has completely evaporated and the pan looks dry.
steps.tip: Do not cover the pan at any point. The whole point of a thoran is dryness.

steps.text: Scatter over the coconut mixture and toss through for 3 minutes until the coconut is heated and smells toasty.
Taste for salt, take off the heat and serve warm alongside rice.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Reheat in a dry pan over high heat for 2 minutes; the microwave makes it soggy.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
nutrition.caveat: Ingredients given to taste rather than by weight are counted as zero, so the real figure is a little higher than this. The + says so.
